name: digline
description: The judgement layer for reading an LLM eval result — when to re-run, when to investigate, what to recommend — and an MCP server that measures, reads and explains, and cannot promote a baseline, because approval is a person's commit; and a hook that asks you before `digline promote` or `digline register` runs, in projects with a .digline/ directory.

tenant.title: Tenant
tenant.description: The tenant whose .digline/ the MCP server reads, passed to it as --tenant. It verifies and never overrides: a suite that declares another tenant is refused. Leave it empty to start the server without one.
